item.title: What Happens When Router Firmware Is Outdated?
item.summary: Like any other piece of technology these days, wireless routers run on software to manage wireless connections, direct internet traffic, provide network security, and often control access between different devices. This software is called firmware, and router manufacturers release firmware updates on a regular basis to fix security vulnerabilities, correct bugs, improve compatibility, enhance performance, [...] The post What Happens When Router Firmware Is Outdated? appeared first on Tech Guide .
